sentences.en: We need to take all of the stakeholders into account.
sentences.zh: 我们需要考虑所有利益相关者。

sentences.en: The company has one stakeholder, who is also its only employee.
sentences.zh: 这家公司只有一个利益相关者，也就是它的唯一员工。

sentences.en: The stakeholder most deeply affected by this decision is the chief executive officer.
sentences.zh: 受此决定影响最深的利益相关者是首席执行官。

senses.zh: 股东；利益相关者；赌金保管者
